title: Standard protocols for detection of human CMV-specific T cells
protocol: Add 20 ml FCS to 30 ml RPMI 1640.
Store Freezing Medium 1 up to 1 month at 4°C.
Add 10 ml DMSO to 40 ml FCS.
Store Freezing Medium 2 up to 1 month at 4°C.
Add 9.3 ml of RPMI 1640 into a falcon tube.
Add 0.5 ml of human AB serum (HABS).
Add 0.1 ml of GlutaMax.
Add 0.1 ml of Pen-Strep.
Pre-cool cryotubes, freezing container, and all reagents to 4°C.
Work on ice using cold reagents in the laminar flow hood.
Add 1 ml Freezing Medium 1 to up to 20 x 10^6 pelleted PBMC.
Incubate for 20 min on ice.
Slowly add 1 ml of cold Freezing Medium 2.
Mix by gently pipetting.
Transfer 1 ml of cell suspension (10 x 10^6 cells/ml) per cryotube.
Place cryotubes in a freezing container and store at -80°C.
Remove cryotubes from the freezing container after 1 day and store them at -80°C for up to 6 months.
Alternatively, store samples in liquid nitrogen for longer than 6 months.
Pre-warm water bath to 37°C.
Thaw cells quickly by swirling the cryotube in the water bath (<60 seconds).
Place cryotube in a cold rack before last ice crystal melts.
Transfer the content of the cryotube into a falcon tube.
Add 10 ml of cold PBS containing 10% human AB serum dropwise.
Count cells.
Centrifuge at 200 g for 10 min.
Aspirate supernatant using vacuum pump.
Resuspend cell pellet in culture medium up to 10 x 10^6/ml.
Add 150 µl of cell suspension per well in a 96-well plate.
Incubate for 6 hours at 37°C, 5% CO2 before proceeding with stimulation.
Add 5 μg/ml CMV lysate to each well.
Add 1 μg/ml αCD28 and αCD49d to each well.
Leave one unstimulated well as a negative control.
Optionally, add 5 μg/ml αPD1, αCTLA-4 or isotype control to the corresponding wells.
Incubate for 18 hours at 37°C in 5% CO₂.
Add 2 µl/ml Protein Transport Inhibitor Cocktail to all wells (0.3 µl of 500X stock per well containing 150 µl medium) during the last 4 hours of incubation.
As a positive control, add 10 μg/ml SEB for 18 hours or alternatively 2 µl/ml Cell Stimulation Cocktail to one well for the last 4 hours.
Transfer cells from culture wells into a polypropylene V bottom 96 well plate.
Centrifuge at 1400 rpm for 3 min.
Resuspend pellet in 20 μl PBS containing ViaKrome Fixable Viability Dye 808 (32.5 µl dye/ml).
Incubate for 20 min at RT in the dark.
Wash samples with 180 μl Cell Staining Buffer (CSB) by centrifugation at 1400 rpm for 3 min.
Aspirate supernatant using vacuum pump.
Add 10 µl 10% FcR block in CSB and shake at 800 rpm for 60 seconds in a rotary shaker.
Incubate at 4 °C for 15 minutes in the dark.
Add 20 µl surface antibodies mastermix as indicated.
Shake at 800 rpm for 5 minutes and incubate for further 25 minutes at 4°C in the dark.
Wash samples with 170 µl CSB by centrifugation at 1400 rpm for 3 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant using vacuum pump.
Add 40 µl CSB to each well and resuspend cell pellets.
Add 50 µl IC Fixation Buffer.
Incubate for 30 minutes at RT in the dark.
Wash samples with 110 µl Perm Buffer by centrifugation at 1400 rpm for 3 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant using vacuum pump.
Add 40 µl intracellular antibody mastermix as indicated.
Shake at 800 rpm for 5 minutes and incubate for further 25 minutes at RT in the dark.
Wash samples with 160 µl Perm Buffer by centrifugation at 1400 rpm for 3 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant using vacuum pump.
Wash samples with 200 µl Perm Buffer by centrifugation at 1400 rpm for 3 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant using vacuum pump.
Resuspend samples in 150 μl CSB for analysis by flow cytometry.
